thread:
Aisha Kaur: quick heads-up 1: our AWS CUR shows a ~$47k charge in Mar for the demo-cluster project, but partner_trial tag is missing. partners billing contact says they were only supposed to be charged $0 for the PoC. need to reconcile before we approve the invoice dispute.
BillingBot: Alert: Unmatched CUR line items detected for account redwood-demo (cost delta > $5k). Suggested files: s3://billing-exports/cur/redwood-2026-03.csv.
Diego Morales: looking now 1: spotted a nightly smoke-test job that spins spot-v100 instances under the demo-cluster autoscaler. the job runs as service:demo-runner@redwood.internal and doesn't propagate tenant_tag. that means CUR attribution fell back to the master account.
Renee Park: oof, that was my test harness. i set it up and forgot to add tenant_tag when cloning the template. i can patch it and re-run the tests, but the historical charge is already there.
Aisha Kaur: ok can you generate a CSV with the CUR line-item IDs + start/end times + instance ids so finance can submit a vendor support case and request an invoice adjustment? we need a clear justification: "partner trial misattributed due to missing tenant_tag on automated tests".
Diego Morales: running an Athena query now. here's the query if you want to preview locally: 

```
SELECT lineItemId,
       lineItemUsageStartDate,
       lineItemUsageEndDate,
       resourceTags_tenant_tag AS tenant_tag,
       product_instanceType,
       bill_type,
       sum(lineItemBlendedCost) AS cost
FROM "aws_cur"."redwood_cur"
WHERE bill_month = '2026-03'
  AND LOWER(product_instanceType) LIKE '%v100%'
  AND resourceTags_tenant_tag IS NULL
GROUP BY lineItemId, lineItemUsageStartDate, lineItemUsageEndDate, resourceTags_tenant_tag, product_instanceType, bill_type
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 500;
```
Diego Morales: i'll drop the export to /shared/finance-temp/demo-cur-march.csv in a few mins.
BillingBot: Note: CUR ingestion time 2026-04-05T02:10:02Z. Recommendation: open AWS support case with lineItemIds and request charge reallocation or credit.
Jonas Becker: from a product perspective we should avoid manual credits when possible. propose we file a vendor case + create a chargeback journal entry so partner invoice is corrected, and then mark internal accounting with a memo for month-end.
Aisha Kaur: agree. finance can approve a temporary journal (cost-transfer) as long as engineering provides the line-item mapping and a timeline for remediation. final approval needs manager sign-off + partner PO reference.
Renee Park: i pushed a PR to the demo-runner job template to enforce tenant_tag and added a retrofit script to tag historic EC2 instances where possible. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/demo-runner/pull/42
Diego Morales: retro-tag script found ~63 instances from Mar 02-08 that can be reconciled. i'll include instance IDs in the CSV.
Aisha Kaur: please also include the partner contact and PO number in the support case. i'll draft the vendor case text and ping legal for contract language.
Jonas Becker: long-term ask: let's add a monthly "partner-demo" audit that runs the Athena query for any untagged GPU instances and auto-alerts finance if > $1k/day. also consider a soft quota of spot V100s per org.
Aisha Kaur: create that alert and link to #billing-alerts. finance will sign off on thresholds. for now i need the CSV and the support case before EOD tomorrow.
Renee Park: CSV uploaded: https://files.internal/shared/finance-temp/demo-cur-march.csv. included notes on which runs were manual tests vs automated smoke-tests.
Aisha Kaur: received. i'll open AWS support case and cc @legal. will post the case number here once submitted. thanks team — huge help getting this actionable quickly. :thumbsup:
